title: Conditional serving eligibility and licensing matrix for onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a rules-driven licensing and restricted-weights matrix that determines conditional serving eligibility and required mitigations for newly onboarded models. This ticket defines the policy, score thresholds, and product controls to automatically mark models as: eligible-for-hosted, eligible-for-dedicated-only, escrow-required, or blocked. The flow must integrate model artifact scanners, license text classifiers, thumbprint of weights provenance, and surface an actionable remediation path in the Console. We must also publish a preliminary performance profile (latency/cost baseline + recommended pin) alongside the eligibility decision so downstream teams can make rollout choices.
acceptance_criteria: Automated license text and SPDX detection runs on every model upload and produces a normalized license id and confidence score.
Weights provenance scanner flags encumbered / restricted weights with a confidence score and a list of artifacts supporting the flag.
A deterministic scoring matrix maps license + provenance signals + model size to one of four eligibility outcomes: hosted, dedicated-only, escrow-required, blocked.
Console shows eligibility, the scoring rationale, and recommended next steps (e.g., request escrow, provide source-of-truth, request exception).

Performance profile generation pipeline attaches a basic runtime profile (median p95 latency at default token length, cost-per-token estimate, recommended quantization) to the model record on completion of checks.
PM/Legal sign-off workflow exists for models that fall in escrow-required or blocked buckets and triggers an embargoed pin if approved.
Integration tests exercise at least three real-model samples (open license, ambiguous license, encumbered weights) and validate end-to-end gating behavior.
Documentation page and a short Console UI help tooltip are published describing the matrix and how to interpret scores.

notes: We opted for a conservative default: anything with license ambiguity or provenance_score < 0.6 requires human review. This reduces false negatives but raises initial latency for onboarding. We will instrument time-in-queue and iterate thresholds after 500 uploads.
implementation_plan: Policy: finalize the scoring matrix and publish to Confluence (owner: PM)
Scanner integration: normalize provenance outputs and expose to onboarding pipeline (owner: ENG)
Console: banner + modal + remediation actions + performance profile link (owner: DES/ENG)
Legal workflow: exception request flow with audit trail and temporary pin/embargo capability (owner: Legal + PM)
Monitoring: funnel metrics for flagged models, manual review latency, and post-approval incidents (owner: SRE/Observability)
Iterate: after 500 onboards, re-evaluate thresholds and automation ratio
